# North UI baseline

Upstream: https://github.com/znjhahaha/zhengfang-apk/tree/e3f2833a2fb1e184968724ee4c7f71ebc816a2dd (v1.0.83), GPL-3.0. The original license and 87 original files are retained and hash-verified. The app now depends on this source via :north-ui; validation/ contains the local integration adapters, not original upstream files. No school/account/network business code is imported in the snapshot. Distribution remains blocked pending whole-application rights and dependency review. See docs/XIAOXU-NORTH-UI-RELEASE-REVIEW.md at repository root.
